Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis has directed the state transport department to develop an artificial intelligence (AI)-based digital platform to monitor app-based passenger transport services. The proposed system will track vehicles, drivers, working hours, trip allocation, parking locations, driving licences and police verification records.
